name: Feature-Driven Ambient Occlusion
definition: A shading technique for direct volume rendering that computes ambient occlusion separately for identified features (layers) to prevent overdarkening of internal layers caused by inter-occlusions from neighboring features, while preserving auto-occlusions.
summary: Feature-Driven Ambient Occlusion is a volume rendering technique that prevents internal layer overdarkening by computing occlusion separately for each feature, ignoring inter-feature occlusions while preserving auto-occlusions.
